releaseNotes:
1. External Google Maps Navigation from Marker Balloon Tip: Added small, prominent 'Navigate' button inside the compact tower marker balloon tip with Google Maps-style navigation icon; one-tap launches Google Maps app (or web browser fallback) with exact tower coordinates as destination in driving travel mode.
2. Marker Options Sheet & Popup Menu Integration: 'Navigate in Google Maps' also accessible via the balloon three-dot popup menu and Marker Options bottom sheet for comprehensive accessibility from both map and right feeder drawer.
3. Robust Coordinate Validation & Tap Debouncing: Coordinates are strictly validated (finite, valid lat/lng boundaries, non-zero) and protected with tap-debouncing cooldown to eliminate accidental double launches; alphanumeric Location Numbers (31A, 4T, 10/1T) preserved.
4. Real-Time OTA CDN Invalidation: Manifest checks updated with cache-busting headers and query parameters to guarantee instant OTA update detection on devices without CDN or proxy delays.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Create New Feeder: Added prominent '+ New Feeder' action in Right Feeder Drawer with form validation against duplicate feeder names, voltage level (110kV/230kV/Other), line type (SC/DC/Other), substations, and remarks; newly created feeder is automatically selected as active.
2. Active Feeder Association & Isolation: Fixed critical legacy bug where new markers defaulted to the first feeder; new markers strictly associate with the currently active feeder; mandatory selection prompt blocks tower addition when no feeder is active.
3. Field Marker Entry & GPS Capture: Displays active feeder name on Add Tower screen ('Saving Tower to: <Feeder>'); supports one-tap device GPS coordinate acquisition or manual lat/lng entry; saves markers using atomic SQLite database transactions.
4. Feeder Marker Audit: Review and audit historical markers associated with feeders via dedicated dialog, allowing safe, user-confirmed reassignment.
5. MAPinr-Level Map Quality & Performance: Integrated permitted high-resolution ESRI World Imagery for Satellite and stacked ESRI World Boundaries & Places reference overlay for Hybrid mode; added in-flight HTTP request deduplication and 2-level (RAM+Disk) caching; eliminated unthrottled setState calls during map gestures for fluid 60fps pan/zoom.
